cross_check_rationale: Relaxed from the plan's 0.001 deg target (physically unachievable). pyswisseph cross-check uses FLG_TRUEPOS | FLG_NOABERR to ALIGN the longitude convention with Ketu's TRUE/no-aberration Sun (ketu/ephemeris/planets.py:190 skips aberration for body_id<2), removing the avoidable ~14-20 arcsec aberration term. The residual is a genuine ephemeris-theory difference: Ketu's bespoke Sun theory diverges from pyswisseph's Moshier theory by up to ~56 arcsec (~0.0157 deg) on multi-decade back-projections. Worst observed resolved-JD delta across the 3 solar fixtures: ~0.005 deg; 0.01 deg ceiling gives a defensible margin while still catching gross solver bugs. See 18-04-NOTES.md.
notes: Standard solar return -- Diana natal (1961-07-01), target_year=1980; natal Sun ~9 deg Cancer, far from seam.
